name: Echo Echo
abilities: Sonic screams (audible to ultrasonic; shatter steel, redirect projectiles, damage Taydenite)
Self-duplication (unlimited clones that act in harmony)
Wall of Sound / echo chamber combo attacks with clones
Audiokinesis and sonic amplification (can scream through phone speakers)
Object and even Omnitrix-user duplication (glitch power)
weaknesses: Number of clones limited by available energy
Vulnerable to fire, neuroshock blasts and Cerebrocrustacean electricity
Can be knocked out by Argit's quills
summary: A tiny white sonic alien who multiplies himself and screams hard enough to shatter steel; strength in numbers rather than size.
traits: Wears headphones so his own screams don't hurt him
One of the smallest Alien Force aliens
notableFeats: Destroyed a mechanical dragon and a pile of Laser Lances in his debut (Ben 10 Returns: Part 2)
Located a Teleporter Pod on Turrawuste by echolocation (Alone Together)
Cloned the Ultimatrix and Ben himself into three Bens (Duped)
Contained a nuclear bomb at the Plumbers' Academy before going Ultimate (The Enemy of My Enemy)
Threw a Plumber ship into a lake with his clones (Prisoner Number 775 is Missing)
Took out Vilgax with a sonic sneeze (The Secret of Chromastone)

appearances.designNotes: Small white silicon humanoid, round head, green sound-hole circles on hands, cassette-like tapes on lower legs, headphones wired to a backpack appendage; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United variant had bigger eyes and a black mouth (non-diegetic flashback only).

notableEpisodes: Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's
appearances.designNotes: Shorter and stubbier: bulging eyes, two black stripes on each earplug, three toes, larger green hand circles, circular stomach mark, leg tapes gone, wider less-round head; Omnitrix symbol on forehead.

scoring.rationale: Small and weak individually but his duplication plus sonic screams form a signature combo (Wall of Sound, echo chamber) that beat Helen and pinned Ultimate Kevin; screams shatter steel and can travel through phones. Survives as long as one clone remains. Vulnerable to fire, electricity and neuroshocks, and clone count is energy-limited.

notes: UA 'Fame' sighting was TV footage; first true UA transformation is Duped.
OV Season 8 uses were by Skurd borrowing Echo Echo's megaphone, not Ben transformations.
Whether Echo Echo is a containment suit is disputed (McDuffie vs. Wyatt); wiki treats him as a natural body.
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
